composition_subtypes.role: greedy choice of x largest items after sorting

payload.core_composition_summary: Sorting then prefix sums for O(1) queries, greedy selection of x highest to maximize free cheapest among them.
payload.rationale: The solution sorts the array and uses prefix sums. For each query, it selects the y cheapest among the x most expensive items. This is a straightforward greedy strategy, not a coordinated multi-mechanism.
